_comment: Curriculum roadmap for the daily 'new unit' scheduled task. Every run, the task builds ONE new unit for EACH of the 6 CEFR levels (not a rotation anymore). Each level's 'queue' is an ordered list of not-yet-built units — the task pops the first item off each level's queue, builds it, removes it from that queue, and bumps that level's nextUnitNumber. If a level's queue is empty on a given day, that level is skipped for the day (noted in the run summary) while the other levels still get built. If ALL 6 queues are empty, set _needsMoreRoadmap to true and stop.

queue.title: Two-Sentence Opinion Paragraph
queue.notes: Opinion sentence + one supporting sentence using 'because' or 'and'.

queue.title: Describing a Trend Over Three Points
queue.notes: Use 'then' and 'after that' to link three time points.

queue.title: Comparing Three Items
queue.notes: Use 'the highest' / 'the lowest' across 3 items.

queue.title: Two Reasons for an Opinion
queue.notes: Use 'firstly' and 'secondly' to sequence two reasons.

queue.title: Describing Change Across a Table
queue.notes: Use 'increase', 'decrease', and 'stay the same' together across a small table.

queue.title: Both-Views Discussion (Intro)
queue.notes: State both sides briefly before giving a personal opinion.

queue.title: Comparing Two Categories Over Time
queue.topic: books vs. videos preference by year
queue.notes: Use a simple 2x2 data table (2 categories x 2 years).

queue.title: Cause and Effect Structure
queue.notes: Use 'as a result' / 'this means that'.

queue.title: Describing a Simple Process
queue.topic: how students sign up for online classes
queue.notes: Describe 2-3 steps in order using 'first', 'next', 'finally'.

queue.title: Problem-Solution Essay Intro
queue.notes: State a problem, then propose one clear solution.

queue.title: Comparing Multiple Data Sets
queue.topic: online vs. in-person classes over 3 years
queue.notes: Push students to avoid repeating 'more than' — offer synonyms.

queue.title: Two-Part Question Response
queue.notes: Prompt has two parts; student must answer both.

queue.title: Pie Chart Proportions
queue.notes: Use 'a quarter of', 'nearly half', 'the majority'.

queue.title: Abstract Topic Discussion
queue.topic: automation and the future of work
queue.notes: Discuss an abstract idea while grounding it in concrete examples.

queue.title: Academic Process Diagram
queue.topic: how an online course is developed
queue.notes: Describe a multi-step academic/institutional process.

queue.title: Extended Cause-Effect-Solution Essay
queue.notes: Cause, effect, then a proposed solution in one flowing paragraph.

queue.title: Map/Diagram Change Description
queue.topic: a university campus before and after expansion
queue.notes: Describe spatial change using directional language.

queue.title: Philosophical IELTS Topic Discussion

queue.title: Full Academic Report Structure
queue.notes: Overview + body paragraphs + comparison combined into one structured report.

queue.title: Critical Evaluation Essay
queue.notes: Critically evaluate strengths and weaknesses of each side.

queue.title: Comprehensive Task 1 Report
queue.notes: Combine overview, comparison, and trend description in one full short report.
